title: Annotated Surrogate Retrieval for Polish Statutory Law
abstract: arXiv:2608.30929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a family of retrieval methods for Polish statutory law built on document surrogates: language-model annotations attached to statutory articles at index time. Three designs occupy different points on the cost-quality frontier. ASCR is a surrogate cascade with reranking; ASCR-H fuses a dense list into that cascade; and DTF replaces both language-model stages with three lexical and dense retrievers, weighted reciprocal rank fusion, and a deterministic re-scoring prior, using no model call before generation. We evaluate all three against fourteen lexical, dense, fused and ablated baselines plus four controls, on 300 questions from the 2024 and 2025 Polish bar and legal counsel entrance examinations (264 with their reference article in the corpus), over 82,508 articles from 1,133 acts. translated_title: 面向波兰成文法的标注代理检索方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一系列基于文档代理的波兰成文法检索方法，其核心是在索引阶段为法律条文附加语言模型生成的标注。三种设计在成本与质量的前沿上占据不同的位置：ASCR 是一种带有重排序的代理级联方法；ASCR-H 将稠密检索列表融合进该级联；DTF 则用三个词法与稠密检索器、加权倒数排名融合以及确定性重评分先验替代了两个语言模型阶段，在生成前无需任何模型调用。我们在来自 2024 年和 2025 年波兰律师及法律顾问资格考试的 300 道题目（其中 264 题的参考条文包含在语料库中）上，针对来自 1,133 部法律的 82,508 条条文，将这三种方法与十四个词法、稠密、融合及消融基线以及四个对照配置进行了评估。在配对 McNemar 检验中，除……外，ASCR-H 将参考条文排在第一位的频率显著高于所有其他非 oracle 配置。
tldr: 该论文提出了三种基于语言模型标注文档代理的波兰成文法检索方法，在律师资格考试题目上显著优于多种基线，并提供了成本与质量之间的不同权衡选择。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a family of surrogate-based retrieval methods for Polish statutory law (ASCR, ASCR-H, and DTF) that attach language-model annotations to legal articles at index time, achieving significantly better retrieval performance than multiple baselines while offering different cost-quality trade-offs.
